summary: 12 findings: 6 medium, 6 low. The single worker finding is retained: /source_caveats asserts that the two admission counts come from sources with "different observation times", which no source states, because only the webinar bullet carries "As of August 2025" while the website's Current Released Dataset snapshot is undated; the compatibility half of the clause is supported and is preserved. No row replacement was required: each reviewed row's claim texts are contiguous literal substrings covering the value at that row's own path, no row quotes a neighbouring or parent slot, and the one revise row remains linked to a retained finding. Eleven new full-record omission findings carry the 21 retained source-stated omissions across description, ethical_reviews, purposes, notes, conforms_to, conforms_to_standard, existing_uses, external_resources, preprocessing_strategies and extension_mechanism, each preserving the source's planned, ongoing, instruction or availability status. Four candidates are dropped: the residual NIH preferred terms (curated indexing vocabulary already sampled by the keywords slot), the training-program organization-eligibility list (applicant administration, not dataset access review), the website taglines (substantively duplicated by the recorded award title and network goal) and the NIH website disclaimer (boilerplate carrying no dataset fact).
